name: Wonder
summary: After Noya is killed in a car crash, her father Avner, a retired combat officer, joins forces with Daria her best friend, to investigate Noya's death. Avner discovers that Noya had a secret virtual life, as part of a movement of teenagers swept up in the world of

name: A Taste of Australia in Vietnam
summary: Luke Nguyen celebrates the Australia-Vietnam relationship, travelling through Vietnam and meeting Australians who represent the spirit of the relationship, cooking with Australian produce, and enjoying regional Vietnamese dishes.

previousepisode.name: Con Dao, Phu Quoc And Bac Lieu

name: Dinner with Gavin Rossdale
summary: This is more than just a cooking show - it's a backstage pass to a world where food, music, and heartfelt conversation collide. In each episode, the iconic band Bush's frontman Gavin Rossdale designs and prepares a sumptuous four-course meal in his Hollywood Hills home, setting the stage for an unforgettable evening with an A-list guest - Serena Williams, Selma Blair, Tom Jones, Common, Jack McBrayer and Brooke Shields. As they cook, dine, and unwind, these celebrity icons shed their public personas to share raw, unfiltered stories about success, challenges, and the human experience.

name: Kitchen Glow Up
summary: Pro cook & designer Ellen Bennett works with homeowners to reimagine their kitchens through a chef's eyes. With an emphasis on function, each kitchen is transformed into a beautifully designed space fit for a chef without spending a fortune.

name: The Guilty
summary: The drama unfolds around a passionate man who hides his crimes to protect his first love and a middle-aged detective seeking redemption by uncovering a brutal truth. A single fatal mistake. An explosion that takes thirteen lives. Two cases that appear entirely unrelated become entwined through the fates of three young people. Across a decade-long journey of investigation and redemption, a buried truth slowly emerges, exposing a shocking secret at the heart of it all.

name: Situationships with Sophie and Christine
summary: Award-winning spicy romance novelist Sophie Gravia and TV personality, model and fellow author Christine McGuinness host a rollercoaster ride of funny, bizarre and downright weird stories of when relationships take an unexpected turn. Whether you need advice on life, love, or best pal boundaries, they are here for it all. Think of them as the latest additions to your group chat. Sophie and Christine delve into your dilemmas and let you in on their own lives, with no topic is off-limits.

name: Lila
summary: Lila is a six year-old girl who is eager to learn new things and enjoy new experiences and the first thing she learns is the importance of acquiring good habits. At first she may not be crazy about them, but as time goes on she accepts them and incorporates them into her life.

name: MY IDOL
summary: Woosang is devastated by the death of his father—and now, even the school track team is about to be disbanded. While everyone urges him to face reality, only Jaemin quietly steps closer to stand by his side.

previousepisode.name: The one who took his hand

name: Je sais pas
summary: A school outing turns into a nightmare. Six-year-old Emma has disappeared into the forest. A search party is immediately organized. Then, as if by magic, Emma reappears. Everyone seems relieved, except that now her teacher, Jade, who went looking for her, is missing.

name: What Really Happened: America's Wild West
summary: The true story of the making of early America.

name: Ben Xian Zun Bu Dang Zhui Xu
Britain's Hotel Murders
summary:
Britain's Hotel Murders uses contemporary footage, newly-shot interviews with eyewitnesses and experts who can piece together the disturbingly dark narratives of the troubling killers who used hotels as their hunting grounds and unsuspecting hideouts.

With compelling first-hand testimonies the series unveils the hidden dangers which the anonymity of overnight stays can present, and the horror stories that have affected the victims to this day.

name: Kacken an der Havel
summary: Rapper Toni returns to his hometown for his mother's funeral and suddenly finds himself juggling career dreams and surprise fatherhood to a teenage son.

name: Pssica
summary: Three lives intertwine in an unexpected way in the rivers of the Atlantic Amazon: Janalice, a young woman kidnapped by human trafficking; Preá, who needs to come to terms with his destiny as the leader of a gang that operates on the region's rivers; and Mariangel, who seeks revenge for the death of her family. The three will try to survive the "psychic", a curse that they believe has been cast upon them.

name: Холод
summary:
Zhenya is unjustly imprisoned for a car accident on Kutuzovsky Prospekt, in which her husband and 6-year-old daughter are killed. The real culprits of the accident are rich kids whose powerful parents "help" the court make the "right" decision.


In the penal colony, Zhenya accidentally saves an influential inmate, Yana, who is serving a sentence for murder. In gratitude, Yana teaches Zhenya how to become stronger in order to take revenge, and helps her escape. Once free, Zhenya gains wealth through Yana's guidance and begins to seek justice against her enemies.

name: Sher
summary: Sher is a gripping Pakistani drama packed with raw emotions, intense rivalries, and deep-rooted traditions. From kidnappings and secret alliances to broken promises and forbidden love, every episode leaves you wanting more.

name: News Anchor
summary: Promoted to lead anchor of a struggling news program, a journalist pushes the boundaries to investigate and expose truths others want buried.

name: Beyond the Bar
summary: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

name: Pararescue Jumper
summary: Chief instructor Seiji Usami trains an elite team of rescue operatives to undergo daring missions in dangerous environments where others fear to go.

name: Bariau
summary: Based on testimonies from real-life prisoners and prison guards, Bariau explores the complex interplay between four central characters on both sides of the law – highlighting the profound impact of the decisions they make on themselves and those around them.

name: Quizfire
summary:
Five candidates sat next to each other in a semi-circle on chairs, which, when a candidate was eliminated, were automatically lowered into the basement of the studio after a visible "buzzer" press from the presenter, thus "sinking" the candidate. The questions came from a wide variety of subject areas and were mostly of a solvable nature.

First, each of the five candidates was asked two open questions, with which they could earn one light for the main round for each correct answer. This began with an open question for everyone, which the fastest candidate was able to answer. If they answered correctly, they were allowed to choose a teammate who then had to answer the next question. Three possible answers were then given, one of which was correct. This round was played until one of the candidates answered incorrectly. One of their lights then went out, or if all the lights went out, the contestant was eliminated. The round then continued with an open question to the remaining candidates.

If three candidates were eliminated within a certain time, the final was held between the last two remaining candidates. Otherwise, the main round was ended and open questions were put to everyone. The first two candidates to answer a question correctly then played the final.

This was played in best-of-five mode with open questions, i.e. the first person to answer three questions correctly won the final.

name: Karma
summary: Karma is a true super hero who originates from Hindu mythology, created to withstand the onslaught of the demonic forces of Markesh.

previousepisode.name: Karma Saves Kaira and Markesh's mother

name: Great Australian Road Trips
summary: From the dirt tracks of the Red Centre Way in the Northern Territory to the Great Barrier Reef Drive in northern Queensland, Kangaroo Island in South Australia to the waterfalls and windswept beauty of Tasmania's western coast, iconic Grand Pacific Drive south of Sydney to the nerve-jangling drive across the East Alligator River, this is the ultimate open road enthusiast's guide to Australia.

name: Smilla's Sense of Snow
summary: Smilla's Sense of Snow centers around Smilla Jaspersen, a Greenlandic woman living in Copenhagen, who investigates the suspicious death of a young Inuit boy, Isaiah, who falls from a rooftop. Smilla's unique "sense of snow" and knowledge of Greenland lead her to uncover a conspiracy involving scientific research and a cover-up.

name: The Sisters Grimm
summary: Two orphaned sisters navigate a town full of people torn straight from fantasy and fairy tales, confronting heroes and villains alike, while investigating the mystery of their missing parents.

name: Hermoso
summary: Back in his hometown to escape a scandal, Kyle finds an unexpected connection with Andres, a quiet fisherman. Just as a new life begins to take shape, Kyle's past threatens to unravel everything — and he must decide if love is worth the risk.

name: SKZ Code
summary: Reality show web series by South Korean boy group Stray Kids. It features the group taking part in different games and activities.

name: Crocodile and Cube: In the Studio
summary: Okay, picture this! Crocodile is a musical genius, but he doesn't have the technical know how.... but his friend, Cube, who has his own audio studio inside a cave, knows HEAPS about audio, technical stuff, has heaps of libraries, but isn't that interested in "creating" songs on his own... Now the fun begins as they try to make a song together!

name: Investigation Shark Attack
summary: Delivering an in-depth look inside the mind of these apex predators, the six-part series explores shark behavior from their unique perspective. An intense forensic investigation at the innovative Shark Headquarters by a panel of scientists analyzes key theories and ultimately dissects each encounter to determine what leads sharks to strike.

name: Shark Quest: Hunt For The Apex Predator
summary: As shark populations are declining, finding ways to share the seas is more critical than ever. In a series of jaw-dropping stories, survivors recount their harrowing encounters with massive sharks ... where some emerged miraculously unscathed and others were less fortunate. By studying the key hot spots that make up the most shark-infested waters in the world, we can learn what attracts these massive predators to frequent these areas. Video evidence can show us how these incredible hunters lean on their highly evolved skills and reveal how we can minimize our risks when entering their domain. Sharks have adapted over 400 million years to become the perfect sea predators, and our survival on land is interlinked with theirs in the sea.

name: Storage Wars: Back to the Locker
summary: Storage Wars: Back to the Locker refers to a series of episodes within the larger "Storage Wars" series, where the focus is on the competitive bidding and treasure hunting within abandoned storage units. These episodes continue the main show's premise of professional buyers vying to acquire the contents of storage lockers, often with the hope of finding valuable items among the discarded belongings. The "Back to the Locker" part emphasizes the return to the core concept of exploring what lies behind the doors of these storage units.

name: Hawk
summary: John Hawk was a full-blooded Iroquois employed as a special detective with the New York City District Attorney's office. With partner Dan Carter, Hawk was assigned to all sorts of different cases, ranging from murder to arson to organized crime. Because of his background, he occasionally dealt with racism inside and outside the department.

name: Judge David Young
summary: Judge David Young is an American arbitration-based reality court show presided over by former Miami-Dade County Circuit Court Judge David Young.

name: Judge Alex
summary: Judge Alex is an American arbitration-based reality court show presided over by retired police officer, lawyer, and Florida Judge Alex Ferrer.

name: Judge Maria Lopez
summary: Judge Maria Lopez is an American arbitration-based reality court show, presided over by Maria Lopez.

name: Family Court with Judge Penny
summary: Family Court with Judge Penny is an American arbitration-based reality court show, presided over by former judge and lawyer Penny Brown Reynolds.

name: Swift Justice
summary: Swift Justice is an American arbitration-based reality court show that was first hosted by HLN host and former Fulton County, Georgia prosecutor Nancy Grace for the first season, followed by former Nevada Eighth District Court/Clark County Judge Jackie Glass for the second and final season.

name: Tangata Pai
summary: Tangata Pai is a drama that tells the story of five people in the last hour of their lives before a bomb is detonated at a Māori protest.

name: Ruo De Chang Yuan Ru Ci Ye
My Thousand-Year Husband
summary: To protect mortal Xie Nanzhi, Dragon Prince Qin Mu willingly sacrifices his heart to ensure her reincarnation. A millennium later, now heartless and dying, he searches for her in the modern world. When they reunite, they must defy fate's cruelty together, but can love conquer a curse forged in sacrifice?

name: End of the Valley
summary: When a land claim faces opposition, Kaea Williams is drawn into a world rich in heritage and mystery, unravelling the secrets of Ngāti Kiokio. The past and present collide in unexpected ways in this season of End Of The Valley.

name: Hospice Heroes
summary: Gives unprecedented access to Tōtara Hospice. From the doctors & nurses to the Hospice Shop staff & volunteers, this series is about the Hospice Heroes working to make life better for palliative care patients.

name: Warren's Vortex
summary:
A father and daughter are swept into a multi-dimensional vortex, embarking on a hilariously twisted journey through alternate realities as they try to find their way back home.

An average Kiwi house. On an average Kiwi street. In an average Kiwi suburb. With an average Kiwi inter-dimensional vortex in the garden shed.

Warren uses his garden wormhole to dispose of grass clippings and household waste. That is until his daughter Lucy falls in and Warren jumps in to rescue her. Father and daughter must now traverse different realities, featuring sentient refrigerators, lethal reality shows, never-ending murder mysteries, and a world where rugby was never invented – and hopefully, find a way home.

name: Small Town Scandal
summary: Small Town Scandal follows Toby, a disgraced journalist turned podcast host, who returns to his rural hometown to investigate the bizarre death of his millionaire uncle - killed, suspiciously, by an automatic lawnmower. As Toby dives deeper into the case, he finds himself surrounded by a cast of quirky, eccentric townsfolk - all with secrets of their own.

name: Crackhead
summary: Crackhead follows the story of Frankie Barker, an addict who burns her sister's house down and ends up spending time at a flashy rehab clinic.

name: New Zealand Tomorrow
summary: Guy Williams roams the motu in search of interesting "future focused stories".

name: Love It or List It NZ
summary: Will Kiwi homeowners love it or list it when The Block NZ winner Alex Walls pitches a stunning renovation, while real estate agent Paul Glover offers a selection of greener pastures?

name: Queer Aotearoa: We've Always Been Here
summary: Join Eli Matthewson for a journey through the untold history of New Zealand's queer community, celebrating the resilience of trailblazers who pushed for an inclusive Aotearoa.

previousepisode.name: Thank You For Your Service...But Not Your Identity: Queer in the Public Sector

name: Choir Games
summary: An uplifting docuseries about the power of music to change lives. Follow two choirs -one from New York City and one from Kaitaia - as they take part in The World Choir Games, which was held in Aotearoa in 2024.

name: Dadolescence
summary: Dadolescence follows the journeys of a group of teenagers as they grapple with the responsibilities of being young dads. The series aims to create a more supportive and inclusive environment for young Kiwi dads and their families.

name: Battlestar Galactica: The Miniseries
summary: A two-part science fiction miniseries that reimagines the original 1978 Battlestar Galactica. Set in a distant star system, humanity is nearly wiped out by a devastating surprise attack from the Cylons—sentient machines originally created by humans. As the last surviving warship, Battlestar Galactica leads a ragtag fleet of civilian ships on a desperate search for a new home: a mythical planet called Earth. The miniseries introduces key characters like Commander William Adama, President Laura Roslin, and the mysterious Number Six, and serves as the official pilot to the critically acclaimed 2004 television series (aired in US in 2005).

name: Chong Hui Qi Ling Wo Neng Wu Xian Chou Jiang
Back to the '80s, Again
summary: In their past lives, Lu Zhaoyan married poor scholar Kuang Yue and became a wealthy matriarch. Her sister Lu Qinning wed officer Ling Yue, only to go mad after his sudden death. After a mutual murder, both sisters rebirth, but when Lu Qinning steals Kuang Yue this time, she doesn't realize Lu Zhaoyan also remembers everything and is still destined to outshine her...

name: Белая амазонка
summary: Journeys through the world's traditions. Travel blogger Alina Vavilonskaya travels to India, Nepal, Indonesia, Mauritania, and Ethiopia to experience the shocking rituals, exotic cuisine, and traditions of various cultures.

name: Yun Shen Buzhi Meng
summary: In the ancient apocalypse, Xihe, a young girl from the Huihua tribe, escaped a devastating rebellion in her tribe's territory. Breaking free from the control of the Qiongming Demon Clan, she embarked on a journey to find the Demon-Slaying Sword, igniting a war between six armies .

name: Het Jachtseizoen: Most Wanted
summary: The men of StukTV are hunting down famous Dutch people. Without phones or money, they have to stay out of Team Stuk's hands for several days. From their high-tech hunting bus, Giel, Thomas, and Stefan get help from the public, who pass on information live. A nerve-racking game of cat and mouse ensues.

name: House of Buggin'
summary: John Leguizamo's edgy sketch comedy show and spiritual sequel to "In Living Color".

previousepisode.name: The Grand Finale: Qucee vs. Nesim

name: Translations
summary: Translations explores the lives of a diverse group of trans individuals and their advocates at a remote retreat in Nova Scotia.

name: En el barro
summary: Five female convicts forge a unique bond after a deadly accident... until corruption and turf wars within a ruthless prison threaten to destroy them.

name: Last Pundit Standing
summary: Fronted by footballing legend Troy Deeney and renowned football YouTuber and presenter James Allcott, Last Pundit Standing follows 12 of the UK's most passionate football fanatics, who love creating content about the beautiful game on their social media channels, as they compete to become BBC Sport's next big football content creator.

name: Queering
summary: Queering is a LGBTQ comedy web series that follows Harper, who is ready to live the best phase of her lesbian life until the tables turn when her mom unexpectedly comes out as queer.

name: Lego Masters Jr.
summary: LEGO Masters Jr. brings imagination, design and creativity to life when junior LEGO enthusiasts (ages 9-17) are paired with a celebrity partner as they go head-to-head with infinite possibilities and an unlimited supply of LEGO bricks. The teams will compete against each other in ambitious brick-building challenges to be crowned the country's most talented amateur LEGO builder. In each episode, the junior builders and their celebrity teammate will work to impress the judges with their incredible creations and then, during the finale, the top teams will face off to win the ultimate LEGO trophy, a $50,000 grand prize and the prestigious title of LEGO Masters Jr.

name: Dom Chinea's Cornish Workshop
summary:
Dom Chinea and his wife Maria (plus their dog Wendy) are moving to Cornwall, having bought an old rundown stone farmhouse, a two-acre field, including a large agricultural barn that Dom is going to turn into his Cornish Workshop. The new series follows Dom as he carves out a new life in the far west of Cornwall. He carries out automotive, engineering and build work, as well as helping neighbours and his new community with their projects.

From buying and fixing an ancient four-wheel drive to enable year-round access to his new workshop, to helping his local church with their bells, to creating a bespoke ice cream vehicle for his neighbour, every episode packs big and little stories alongside the narrative of creating his new workshop from an ancient barn. Throughout the series, Dom enlists the aid of Sam Lovegrove for general engineering assistance, plus a cast of charismatic, local trades people who collectively help Dom to achieve his ambitious plans.

name: Gal Pals
summary: Gal Pals is a comedy about the interwoven lives of a group of LGBT women living in Los Angeles…created by LGBT women living in Los Angeles. It's The L Word for the Broad City generation. Season One follows Bee, whose self-destructive game of cat and mouse comes to a halt when she starts falling for one of her seemingly straight targets.

name: Tout pour la lumière
summary: Back in her hometown of La Ciotat, a singer who gave up the stage returns to music, and must navigate between family secrets and young talent at the Studio Lumière.

name: The Winning Try
summary:
Joo Ka-Ram used to be a rugby player who was the hope for Korean rugby. He had talent and star potential, but a drug scandal ruined everything. All of the sports media covered his drug scandal. He retired from the sport under the stigma of a drug addict. 3 years later, he returns as a contract coach for the high school rugby team where he once played for. The high school rugby team is the weakest team in its league. As a coach, Joo Ka-Ram shows unrivaled charisma and an uncompromising leadership ability. He also reunites with his ex-girlfriend Bae Yi-Ji (Lim Se-Mi), who is a shooting coach at the same high school. They dated for 10 years, but, after his drug scandal, Joo Ka-Ram disappeared. Now, they reunite again while working at the same high school.

Meanwhile, the rugby team has 7 players including its captain Yoon Seong-Joon. Yoon Seong-Joon is in the 3rd year of high school. He has a twin brother who is a member of the junior national soccer team. Yoon Seong-Joon also played soccer in the past, but he switched to rugby due to his lack of talent. He is twisted by envy and feels inferior toward people with talent. Yet, Yoon Seong-Joon is a hard-working person who wants to be recognized in sports.

name: Movers
summary: Movers is an improvised workplace comedy revolving around the erratic and codependent lives of a crew of movers.

name: Roller Coaster
summary: Pure and Air ended because Air chose to marry for business, following her parents' wishes. Although the two ended, Pure couldn't move on or open her heart to anyone else before she met Loft. It's a love triangle, since Air is still in love with Pure too. Living a carefree life has begun to take its toll. Jumping into a rollercoaster of a relationship is giving these thrill seekers a taste of feelings beyond joy.

previousepisode.name: The end of Air Pure Loft

name: Secret Lover
summary: Han Tuo and Jun Xi have grown up together since they were kids, and they have a strong friendship until they both act in a university play together. Tuo challenges his friend under the guise of 'relationship training,' and a boundary gets crossed. From fake dating to fake kissing to real love, Jun Xi gradually is moved by Tuo's sincere feelings as they step into a different kind of relationship...

previousepisode.name: Love Is a Secret That Can't Be Hidden

name: A Sketchy Job
summary: Lu Xiao, a university student, applies for an unconventional job to make ends meet: a fake boyfriend service. In this job where he will work as a "boyfriend-for-hire", all he has to do is play certain roles in front of his clients and maintain this relationship without forming any emotional attachment. Everything goes according to his rules... until he meets his new client, Liu Zai Rong.

name: The Daily Briefing with Dana Perino
summary: Dana Perino is the host of 'The Daily Briefing,' in which she explores the major issues that Americans are facing today. Prior to joining the network, Perino served as the White House press secretary for President George W. Bush, making her the first female press secretary in the Republican administration.

name: Moko
summary:
The decline of traditional tā moko (Māori tattoo) and its modern-day revival is explored in a compelling story of survival, self-determination, courage, healing and reclamation of identity.

Moko features tā moko artists, Māori academics, and wearers of tā moko speaking directly to issues of colonisation, intellectual property rights, and the tikanga that guides and defines tā moko in Aotearoa.

name: Guilty Maid
summary: To investigate her sister's missing after marrying into the Shen family, Su Yunqing infiltrates Shen's household disguised as a maid, only to be trapped in deadly inner-court schemes. Each breakthrough in her investigation triggers a forced soul-transmigration into the body of a villain, hurling her into mortal peril. Amidst the ups and downs, Su Yunqing develops feelings for Shen Xingyan, Shen family's heir. These bizarre transmigrations gradually help her unveil the truth — exposing generations of blood feuds and a conspiracy that shatters both families. How will she fight to survive while safeguarding the forbidden love?

previousepisode.name: As Sorrows of Parting Fade, the Moon Lights Our Homeward Path

name: Every Woman
summary: Geordie Shore's Sophie Kasaei has openly discussed her aspiration to start a family with her partner and TOWIE star, Jordan Brooks.  In this new digital-first series, she plans to share every step of her fertility journey with fans in a bid to raise awareness and understanding of the many different journeys that can be undertaken to have children.

previousepisode.name: Sophie Kasaei Meets Fertility Friends As She Plans For The Future

name: Xiu Fu San Shi Liu Ji
Poju Zhi Nu Qi Shen De Ni Xi Zhi Lu
Mirrored Souls a Ming Dynasty Mystery
Jogo Cruzado
summary: A journalist and a former player who hate each other share the desk of a daily sports show.

name: Выживалити. Наследники
summary: Since childhood, they had everything: money, opportunities and popularity. But what are they worth without their star moms and dads? The heirs of famous families will go to an uninhabited island to survive and find their own name.

name: Demascus
summary: Demascus follows Demascus, a Black man who goes on a journey of self-discovery using an experimental reality-bending technology. The series is a comedic, genre-defying, coming-of-age story that explores the gulf between Black male perspectives.

name: Johnny Vegas' Little Shop of Antiques
summary: Actor and comedian Johnny Vegas embarks on a new adventure: opening an antiques shop in Lancashire. Can he turn his ramshackle dream into a business?

name: Poisoned: Killer in the Post
summary: The investigation into a British man's death leads to a dark online world of suicide forums, and the pursuit of an online vendor selling lethal poison to over a thousand young people.

name: Der Germinator
summary: Manfred Gilow emigrated from Germany to Texas years ago and works as a police chief in the town of Hawkins. The settlement has changed a lot over the years. Where oil wells once brought prosperity to the inhabitants, there are now all the more criminal cases. Many livelihoods are on the brink of collapse, which is why thefts and domestic violence have been on the rise for years. The German-American Gilow is on the side of the law and has his hands full enforcing it here.

name: Love, Take Two
summary: Lee Ji Ahn has built her life on strength, dignity, and quiet resilience as a single mother. But everything shifts when her grown daughter, now a med student, stages a late rebellion-and Ji Ahn nexpectedly reconnects with her first love, Ryu Jung Suk. As mother and daughter navigate personal turning points, they discover something neither expected: the right to choose joy, love, and themselves -this time around. Not every love story happens in your twenties.

previousepisode.name: To All of Our First Love

name: El clan Olimpia
summary: Inspired by a true story, El clan Olimpia is the story of a woman, mother, and wife who, forced to support her family, begins selling hashish in a neighbourhood plaza and ends up becoming one of the world's biggest drug traffickers.

name: Il Mostro
summary: Eight double murders. Seventeen years of terror. Always the same weapon. A .22 caliber Beretta. One of the longest and most complex Italian investigations into the first and most brutal serial killer in the country's history: Il Mostro di Firenze. A series based on true events, direct testimonies, procedural documents and journalistic investigations. All terribly true. Because we believe that telling the truth, and only that, is the only way to bring justice to the victims. In a story where there have been many possible monsters, over time and investigations, our story focuses on them, the possible monsters, from their point of view. Because the monster, in the end, could be anyone.

name: Conversations with a Killer: The Son of Sam Tapes
summary: One of the greatest manhunts in New York City history comes to life in this gripping three-part series. Conversations with a Killer: The Son of Sam Tapes takes viewers inside the NYPD's desperate race to catch the infamous .44-caliber killer—and into the disturbing mind of David Berkowitz himself. Newly unearthed recordings offer rare insight into his twisted psyche, revealing what was going through his mind as he unleashed a reign of terror in the late 1970s. Alongside firsthand accounts from cops, journalists, and survivors, the series unpacks how fear spread through the streets, fueled by cryptic letters, a frenzied press, and a killer who seemed to be everywhere and nowhere at once. From Emmy-winning and Academy Award nominated director Joe Berlinger, this chilling new chapter of Conversations with a Killer delves into one of the most infamous cases in American history.

name: 4 Elements: The Earth
summary: Rose Thippapha, heir to the Chomjan acreage, returns from America when an accident befalls her stepfather and she finds herself in danger from Wasu, a vineyard owner who seeks to snatch up her land for his illegal business operations. Fortunately, Rose's childhood friend and owner of an organic vegetable farm Din Kasama Wathinwanit comes to protect her. To secure her safety, she and Din will have to marry. Even if it's only a sham marriage, their reestablished closeness gradually brings about real feelings.

name: 4 Elements: The Fire
summary: Atjima Wathiwanit, the heiress to a southern millionaire, is reunited with Kaphrao Athittaya, her childhood rival. Their relationship is like the flames of fire and oil; it may cause the fire of love to blaze or crack again.

name: Família é Tudo
summary: To receive their grandmother's inheritance, five siblings will have the mission of living together and starting a profitable business. Amid joys, adventures, and conflicts, they will discover that family is everything.

name: Qi Zi Ni Xi Shou Ce
Yi Zhi Hun Shu Ding Liang Yuan
Running with the Wolves
summary:
Running with the Wolves follows daytime television icons Mark Consuelos and Kelly Ripa as they dive headfirst into the high-stakes world of Italian football—not as spectators, but as team owners. 

Set in the heart of southern Italy, Running with the Wolves chronicles the couple's bold journey as owners of Campobasso FC, a gritty Serie C soccer club known as the "Lupi" (Italian for "Wolves"). Since taking the reins in 2022, Consuelos and Ripa have helped breathe new life into the once-struggling team and reignited passion among the club's loyal fanbase.

Now, as the Wolves enter the 2025 campaign, the stakes have never been higher. Injuries affect the team as a relentless head coach pushes players to the brink, while Mark and Kelly feel the pressure of the fans' demands. The Wolves' margin for error is slim as they teeter from a playoff team to facing relegation. Through it all, viewers get an unprecedented look at how Mark and Kelly balance the pressures of ownership, family life, their careers—and the dream of leading Campobasso FC to glory. Running with the Wolves is a dramatic, inspiring, and often humorous behind-the-scenes look at what it takes to transform a soccer club.

name: Wang Ye, Nin Jia Wang Fei You Zuo Yao La
Solo Traveling with Tracee Ellis Ross
summary: Tracee Ellis Ross is an award-winning actress, producer, founder of PATTERN Beauty, and fashion icon. Now, she is packing her bags and inviting audiences to join her solo trips to Morocco, Mexico, and Spain to experience the joy of solo travel. "This is me enjoying my own company while I immerse, unplug, and indulge out in the world."

name: Off Road
summary: Two Israeli actors embark on an unforgettable road trip across Central Asia to learn more about themselves and the people they encounter along the way.

name: Guerreiros do Sol
summary: The story of two country folk, Josué and Rosa, and how they meet to become one of the most famous cangaceiro couples of all time.

name: Mundo da Lua
summary: The children's series that marked generations in the 1990s is back with new chapters of the Silva and Silva family. The sequel introduces Emília, daughter of Lucas Silva e Silva, as the new protagonist. Now, the famous recorder, who accompanied Lucas in his imaginary stories, is joined by the robot Felix, who will be with Emília in the plot. She is a creative, intelligent girl who is passionate about robotics, who also daydreams and narrates her stories with the iconic phrase "Hello, Hello! Planet Earth Calling".

name: Barbapapa en famille !
summary: The adventures of Barbapapa, Barbamama and their seven children: Barbotine the intellectual, Barbabelle the flirt, Barbidur the little tough guy, Barbibul the inventor, Barbidou the animal lover, Barbouille the painter and Barbalala the musician. These funny and very colorful characters have the ability to transform themselves into objects of their choice...

name: Critics Choice Real TV Awards
summary: The Critics' Choice Real TV Awards are accolades for nonfiction, unscripted and reality television content presented by the Critics Choice Association and NPACT.

name: Moni
summary: After ten years away, Moni, a gay Samoan man, returns to Sydney determined not to miss his sister Hana's wedding. But an unexpected arrival throws things into disarray.

name: Pour le meilleur et à l'aveugle
summary: Divided into pods, French singles date and get engaged — sight unseen. Is love truly blind? A social experiment hosted by Luthna Plocus and Teddy Riner.

name: Watch What Happens Live! After Show
summary: The Watch What Happens Live! After Show offers viewers additional, unedited, and often more candid moments from the main show, featuring extra banter, behind-the-scenes content, and extended conversations with guests. It provides a deeper dive into the topics discussed on the main show and allows for more interactive engagement with the audience through polls and questions.

name: Menem: El Show del Presidente
summary: Menem, an extravagant and charismatic politician, becomes president of a troubled nation. His term, marked by privatization of public enterprises, dollarization of the economy, and consulting fortunetellers, is overshadowed by terrorist attacks and the death of his son. His photographer, Olegario Salas, witnesses his life change along with Argentine society amid economic recovery and corruption.

name: From the Ground Up
summary: Football legend Ian Wright steps off the studio set and onto the pitch in a heartwarming new series that sees him launch the first-ever girls' under-14 team at his childhood club.

name: Gao Leng Shi Zi De Zhang Xin Chong
Michael Mosley: Secrets of the Superagers
summary: Michael travels the world to meet people who seem to defy the normal rules of ageing and learn the secrets and the science behind ageing well.

name: Adaptive: Paris
summary: A profile of the personal and professional lives of world-class Paralympic athletes, highlighting the power of sport through community and advocacy.

name: Wo Cai Mei You Bang Jia Nv Ming Xing
13 Hours to Survive
summary:
13 Hours to Survive is an up-close look at the epic drama that occurs with the coming of each low tide. As the ocean recedes, sea animals become trapped in tide pools. In these miniature oceans the natural order is overturned and a struggle to survive is unleashed.

The creatures have thirteen hours to survive, the time it takes for the tide to return. This underwater arena could be anywhere in the world, but this stunning series takes place near Roscoff in Brittany, France, with breathtaking windswept coasts that experience a daily tidal shift of 10 meters or more.

name: Crime Night!
summary:
Julia Zemiro will host Crime Night! a comedy true-crime panel show where real-life cases are examined through the lens of criminology and comedy.

Produced by Dreamchaser and Maverick Entertainment, the six-part series will see Julia, alongside a panel of criminologists and comedians dissect famous cases. They will discover the science behind the crimes and use that same science to examine our own lives with hilarious consequences.

name: Sport vs Money with Simon Jordan
summary: Sport vs Money tells the inside story of the collision between football and business. Across four episodes, Jordan - the Premier League's youngest-ever owner - travels the globe to explore how decisions made by football's top executives in the early 1990s set in motion a transformation that has turned the world's most beloved sport into a vast entertainment industry.

name: Junk or Jackpot?
summary: The show follows collectors as they discover the true monetary value of their massive and unusual collections. From an overwhelming stash of superhero figurines to cramped spaces stuffed with rare puppets and dolls and miniature sets that leave no room for actual, life-size furniture – these homes are begging for professional help, and the collectors must decide whether they are willing to sell some of their items to pay for the much-needed renovation. With a combination of humor, compassion and a celebration of the passionate collector in all of us, Bobby will support the homeowners through the process of sorting through, appraising and letting go of their stockpile, discovering the ‘found money' along the way to achieving their dream makeover.

name: The Blade of Romance
summary: Song Weiwei, the daughter of the first general of the Chen Kingdom, is determined to avenge the death of her father and the destruction of her kingdom. She replaces Wen Wenrou, the sister of Wen Zhiyuan, the most favored prince of the Liang Kingdom. She gradually gains Zhiyuan's trust, and even makes him fall in love with her. With the help of Wen Zhibai, who is fighting for the throne against Zhiyuan, she gradually dismantles Zhiyuan's plan of ascending the throne, succeeding in her revenge. However, she realizes that Zhiyuan has really fallen in love with her, and her crush has also been silently guarding her...

name: Starfire
summary: Starfire is a new animated series that explores the origin story of the iconic Teen Titan as she embarks on galactic adventures after discovering a spaceship on her home planet, Tamaran. The show will feature characters like Crush, Fern, and Princess Amethyst, with promises of space exploration, saving space dolphins, and surfing technicolor nebulas, though no release date has been set yet.

name: My Adventures with Green Lantern
summary: This animated series will follow teen Jessica Cruz, who becomes the new Green Lantern after receiving a Power Ring, but her new powers bring challenges as debris and enemies from the Lantern's war arrive on Earth. With no release date confirmed yet, the show is being executive produced by Jake Wyatt and co-executive produced by Stephanie Gonzaga.

name: DC Super Powers
summary: DC Super Powers is an animated series set at the Alliance School for Heroes, where new students like Lightning, Flash, Plastic Man, Aquagirl, Green Lantern, and Terra train to become the next generation of crimefighters.

name: Blue Beetle
summary: An animated continuation of Jaime Reyes' story following Blue Beetle. While the movie didn't do as well at the box office, this series keeps the character going in a new medium.

name: Krypto
summary: Follows Krypto the Superdog.

name: Baby Farm
summary: A young pregnant woman accepts help from a high-profile organization offering support — and becomes a prisoner in their sinister plot.

name: Pad
summary:
The story of the series begins late in the evening, in July 1993, at the moment when two brothers, Ivan and Stojan, arrive at their uncle's apartment, not far from the place where a conflict with tragic consequences just happened in Podgorica.

The story continues in SPUŽ pre-trial prison. In parallel, we get to know the relationship between Ivan and his father Nikola, a serious and rational man, with whom Ivan has had a complicated relationship since childhood. These two stories are complicated and expanded, illuminating on the one hand the seductive life of one of Yugoslavia's biggest acting stars, but also the dark side of the nineties, the corrupt judiciary, the prison half-world. 

A gallery of colorful characters that our hero meets in prison, thieves, criminals, murderers, political prisoners, the atmosphere of the nineties in which all social and moral values were questioned, the key breaks in his intimate life, his relationship with his closest relatives, family, friends, courtroom scenes, his relationship to fame and popularity.

name: With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess
summary: Lua is a saintess candidate who possesses the power of healing. But her ability had one flaw: she could only heal others by transferring their wounds onto herself. Because of this, others bullied her, calling her the "Fallen Saintess." But it didn't bother Lua because her best friend Arianne always stood up for her. One day, Lua's crush, Commander Garrett, was on the brink of death from a beast attack. Lua healed him, which left her on the verge of death. When she woke up, she learned that all the credit was given to Arianne, and she finally saw her best friend's true color. Devastated, Lua is lost and helpless when the second prince appears in front of her with a tempting offer. What would happen to Lua as she begins her new life as a villainess?

name: Zhong Zhi Ren Sheng De Shi Kong You Xiang
A Gentleman is Like a Mu
Blend Feelings
summary: Jian Xiangxiang, a traditional incense maker, is devastated by a double betrayal—her boyfriend, Gu Jiacheng, betrays her in both love and career. Just when she's at her lowest, a barrage of mysterious on-screen comments (danmu) suddenly appears out of thin air, mocking her relentlessly. At first, Jian thinks she's hallucinating. But after several events unfold exactly as predicted, she realizes the comments have the power to foretell the future. They clearly warn her: in three months, Gu Jiacheng will have her committed to a psychiatric hospital. Determined to defy fate and take revenge, Jian sets her sights on Gu Jiacheng's third uncle—Gu Jingshi. Though Gu Jingshi is in a wheelchair, he exudes the cold, commanding aura of a true power player and is, in fact, the real head of the Gu family. Jian knows that tears and tantrums are for losers. If she wants Gu Jiacheng to fall to his knees and beg for forgiveness, she must become his aunt—Gu Jingshi's woman. Thus begins a calculated game of seduction that starts with strategy… and ends in irresistible obsession.

name: Wild Fire
summary: In a chaotic era, a rich scion finds himself in love with a humble actress. Bound by social hierarchy, haunted by public rumors, and betrayed by their kin, their scarred hearts still inch closer with great care. The vibrant city hides undercurrents of conflict. Even a small stage reflects the turbulent times. No matter the difficulties, they vow to love fiercely amidst the turmoil.

name: Dear My Baby: Watashi ga Anata wo Shihai suru made
summary: In the spring of 2025, a shocking incident occurs where a popular actor stabbed his female manager with a knife and the news shocks the whole of Japan. Yoshikawa Keiko is a veteran manager at the bottom of despair when she happens to pass Moriyama Takuto on the street. Feeling a connection with him, Keiko invites him in the world of entertainment and does everything to make him debut as an actor. Slowly, Keiko invades Takuto's friendship and private life, and her love for him gradually escalates way beyond the role of a manager.

name: Catalog
summary: A recently widowed workaholic clumsily navigates life with his kids, guided by his late wife's online tips. Can he ace this crash course in parenthood?

name: The Switch
summary: Moments before her death, Fang Siyu learns the brutal truth, her husband Zhou Kai and best friend Jiang Yiyi swapped her newborn, murdered Jiang's husband Song Cheng, and plotted to silence her forever. Given a second chance, Fang joins forces with the resurrected Song Cheng to expose the conspiracy and cheat fate. As vengeance binds them, love blooms; together they unravel the villains' scheme, rewrite destiny, and step into a future forged by their own hands.

name: Rogue History
summary: It's been said that history is written by those in power. But what about the outlaws, outcasts and rogues? What if they had their say? Rogue History shakes the dust off the history books to unravel myths, unearth narratives, and discover fresh perspectives.

previousepisode.name: The Indigenous Rebellion That Terrified the Colonies

name: Gomen ne Seishun!
summary: 31-year-old Hara Heisuke is a teacher at a high school in Shizuoka. He is like most people rather than an exceptional person. But an unfortunate accident which occurred 14 years ago ended up messing up his life. Feeling responsible, he stuck to his hometown and alma mater from then on. Meanwhile, it is decided that the boys school where he works will be merged with a girls school in the same area because of a decline in student numbers next year.

name: Ren'ai Shinkaron
summary: A spin-off on #Remolove: Futsuu no Koi wa Jado drama.

name: Michael Savage: Savage Nation
summary: Michael Savage delivers his insights on politics, culture, faith and more as he seeks to save Western Civilization!

name: Circus
summary: Follow the lives of circus artists as they go about their daily routines surviving the twists and turns life throws at them.

name: Phir Bhi Dil Hai Hindustani
summary: Phir Bhi Dil Hai Hindustani chronicles the family of Bharat Bhushan, a perfect patriot. Bharat's (Translation: India's) family includes his three sons – Om, Jai, and Jagdish, his three daughters-in-law – Ganga, Jamuna, Saraswati and his four grandchildren – Ram, Shyam, Munna and Munni, all of whom live in a house named Bharat Niwas (Translation: India House) and personify the multi – cultural diversity of India.

name: Tonight, On the First Basement Floor of Babel
Shan Hun Hou Lu Zong You Zheng You Qiang
Enoc Huws
summary: Serial play by Daniel Owen.

name: Treflan
summary:
The period drama, Treflan, is based on three books by Daniel Owen, the novelist and tailor from Yr Wyddgrug, namely Y Treflan, Rhys Lewis and Enoc Huws. 

Set in the Victorian era the series follows the story of popular characters from the novels who live in a small town typical of Daniel Owen's hometown in Yr Wydgrug in the 19th century. During this period religion, the industrial revolution and the agricultural industry played a prominent role in people's lives.

name: Bettany Hughes' Lost Worlds: The Nabataeans
summary: With exclusive access to astonishing new research, historian Bettany Hughes unravels the enigma of the Nabataeans: the influential ancient people who history forgot.

name: Aller simple : la téléréalité
summary: Thomas Rouclair and Éli Mandokan are at the helm of this social experiment in which ten visitors, each with a secret, are brought together in an isolated chalet. Every day, one murderer, one victim. They will have to lie, investigate and murder. And only one will walk away a winner with up to $50,000.

name: Fabelhafte Insekten
summary: Without them, the natural balance would be thrown out of balance: Ants and beetles maintain their environment through composting and pollination. They also fascinate with their survival strategies – from the leaf-cutter ant, which cultivates mushrooms, to the oil beetle, which sneaks into beehives. A journey to these colorful and bizarre six-legged creatures, both in the South American rainforest and here in Europe.

name: Language Of Light
summary: Looks at seven Australian photographers, each with an impressive body of work and unique photographic style

name: Tordyveln flyger i skymningen
summary: In the small town of Ringaryd in Småland, three young people find a chest with hidden letters. The letters tell of a 3,000-year-old statue that has disappeared under mysterious circumstances. It turns out that a curse rests on the statue and strange things start to happen when the past catches up with them. The series is based on the beloved classic by Maria Gripe and Kay Pollak.

name: Таксопарк № 13
summary: Sergei Yesaulov's life can be called ideal — he has a job he loves, a wife and a beautiful daughter. Everything changes when a banal family quarrel leads to irreversible consequences: the daughter gets into an accident, and Yesaulov finds his wife strangled in bed. From that moment on, the man becomes the main suspect in the murder. Sergei begins his own investigation to figure out and punish the killer. And in order not to stay on the street, he gets a job at taxi company No. 13.

name: Cinderella Closet
summary: Haruka is a "plain jane" who left the countryside to start her college life at Tokyo. She's secretly in love with Kurotaki, a coworker at her part-time job, but she lacks the self-confidence to confess her feelings to him. Then she meets Hikaru, a glamorous but sharp-tongued fashionista who begrudingly agrees to play "fairy godmother" for Haruka. However, there's more to Hikaru than meets the eye!

name: Delirio
summary: When his wife Agustina falls into delirium, a professor delves into her dark past to piece together her story and uncover the cause of her madness.

name: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
summary: Everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Kriti Gupta.

name: DogBro
summary: Meen, a fifth-year medical student, cherishes a studious life filled with the joyful company of friends like Bon, Flint, Kim, Baikhao, and Pokpong. One day, Meen's mother sends Tul, the son of her close friend, who has recently passed the entrance exam to pursue engineering at Chiang Mai University, the top-ranked institution in the country, to live with Meen and assigns Meen to take care of Tul. Meen sees this as a good opportunity for him to move to a dorm near the university and have Tul take care of Nirand instead. But before moving out, Meen learns that behind Tul's excellence as a student lies a struggle with depression. Driven by his medical training and compassion, Meen makes the selfless choice to abandon the dormitory plan to support and care for Tul. As they live together for a while, their relationship develops beyond just "brothers." Both must choose between a romantic relationship or ending it as mere "brothers" to fulfill their life goals.

name: My Lovely Journey
summary: A full-fledged healing trip emotional drama about an idol-turned-travel reporter who has never been in the center in her life, realizing the true success and meaning of life by going on requested trips.

previousepisode.name: Amber: a 100 million year old tail.

name: Vse punce mojga brata
summary: Brothers joint apartment will become too small for both of them and all their loves and whose experiences they drew material for the series.

name: What You Need To Know
summary: What You Need to Know is the fast, fresh way to stay ahead of the conversation as viewers start their day. From breaking headlines and the day's biggest stories to entertainment buzz and viral videos, the show has everything you need to know.

name: Reactions
summary: Reactions is a show that uncovers the chemistry all around us. We answer the burning questions you've always wanted to ask, blending the worlds of science and every-day life.

name: Sacred Planet with Gulnaz Khan
summary: Sacred Planet with Gulnaz Khan is a four-part, four-hour series presented by the environmental journalist, Gulnaz Khan. Cinematic in its approach and global in its ambitions, the series was filmed in Africa, Asia, and North & South America. It is a deeply personal and often uplifting examination of how climate change is impacting some of the most hallowed places on the planet, and how faith leaders worldwide are seeking to mitigate the worst consequences of the climate crisis by drawing on traditional knowledge, practices, and beliefs.

name: Midnight Feature
summary: A nomadic curator spends his days rummaging through lost footage that he randomly "finds" from strangers. He's so proud of his collection that he's decided to share it with everyone in this episodic found footage anthology dubbed his Midnight Feature.

name: Impaulsive
summary: With nearly a billion views on YouTube alone, "IMPAULSIVE" has become one of the world's biggest digital series since launching in November 2018. The show has featured interviews with some of the biggest and most intriguing names in entertainment, sports and culture, including WWE Superstars such as Cody Rhodes, Roman Reigns and Rhea Ripley. Other notable guests have included Tom Brady, Kevin Hart, Machine Gun Kelly, MrBeast and more. "IMPAULSIVE" is co-hosted by Mike Majlak, a founder of the digital series alongside Logan Paul, and a USA Today best-selling author and multi-platform content creator with more than 4.4 million followers across YouTube, Instagram and other social platforms.

previousepisode.name: Kane Brown Addresses Morgan Wallen, Racism In Country Music, Megan Moroney & Jelly Roll - EP. 464

name: Emerald
summary: A bold and enchanting new original, Emerald, based on the much-loved book series by Harriet Muncaster (Isadora Moon). It follows a mermaid princess who swims to the beat of her own drum as she faces unexpected adventures and changing family dynamics. Emerald does things her way – with joy, creativity and plenty of heart. The series features Shelly the Turtle voiced by Adjoa Andoh MBE (Bridgerton).

name: Jaime's Treetop Tales
summary: Jaime's Treetop Tales invites children into Jaime's cosy treehouse for imaginative story time adventures inspired by everyday objects. Led by Jaime Amor, a beloved storyteller with over 400 million views across all social platforms, the series encourages simulated play and creative thinking through original characters and playful narratives, while offering calm, connected moments for young viewers.

name: Death of a Showjumper
summary:
Death of a Showjumper details the shocking death of Katie Simpson, a promising young showjumper, which devastated the horse community in Northern Ireland, exposing hypocrisy, secrets and violence under the surface of a seemingly perfect and privileged world.

When Katie Simpson, died unexpectedly in 2020, the majority of the horse community accepted that she had taken her own life but a local journalist questioned the official conclusion. Katie's death triggered a memory of an old case she covered, a case with too many similarities to Katie's. At the centre of her suspicions was Katie's sister's partner, an influential champion showjumper, jockey and horse trainer, Jonathan Creswell.

name: Stories from Tate Britain
summary: Having explored the collections of the National Portrait Gallery and the National Gallery, Kate Bryan goes behind the scenes at Tate Britain. The collection includes works by some of the most celebrated artists in British culture, from William Blake to Chris Ofili, as well as an astonishing archive.

name: Shin Kuukou Senkyo Mae: Run, Mouse, Run!
summary: This two-episode prequel explores the events leading up to the airport occupation, revealing key backstories and the circumstances that set the stage for the looming crisis.

name: Housoukyoku Senkyo
summary: When a broadcasting station is overtaken by a radical group, a seasoned investigator faces a tense standoff that threatens to disrupt the nation's communication. As secrets unravel, he must outwit the occupiers to restore order.

name: Sundome
summary: When a beautiful girl, Kurumi Hayaka, transfers into the class of Hideo Aiba, the head of the photography club at high school, Aiba falls in love with Kurumi. However, he soon finds himself at the mercy of her devilish attitude and behavior. What will happen to their twisted SM-like relationship?

name: Full Swing
summary: Golf-based game show in which celebrities win money for charity and prizes for their contestant partners.

name: A Killer Among Friends
summary: Explores a group of interconnected individuals who are collectively haunted by a murder of one of their own, serving as the catalyst to unravel secrets, suspicions, and betrayals between friends.

name: Sweet Revenge
summary: Sweet Revenge is a stylish romantic revenge drama about Mariko, a quiet and unassuming woman who secretly runs a company called Sweet Revenge Inc. Her mission: to help women who've been cruelly dumped by making the offending men fall for her — only to ruthlessly break their hearts in return. A master of disguise and seduction, Mariko transforms into the ideal woman for each target, tailoring her looks, personality, and behavior to their desires. But as she dishes out justice one case at a time, the line between revenge and emotion begins to blur. Sharp, clever, and unexpectedly heartfelt, Sweet Revenge delivers both satisfaction and insight into the games of love.

name: B:My Boyz
summary: B:My Boyz aims to create a new global boy group. The show will feature 30 talents selected from Korea, Japan, China, Thailand, and beyond, with the goal to debut as the next generation idols. The participants will compete against each other in various fields including vocals, performance, and producing, with the current top idol seniors selecting the next idols.

name: Her Last Broadcast: The Abduction of Jodi Huisentruit
summary: A TV show anchor vanishes in 1995 under mysterious circumstances, but the biggest leads in decades could mean finally solving the chilling cold case.

name: Neko Kare: Shounen wo Kau
summary:
What happens when two lost souls—one a woman weary of adult life, the other a boy with nowhere to go—start living under the same roof?

Ai, a 30-year-old office worker numbed by the monotony of daily life, finds herself making an impulsive decision one rainy night: taking in a stray high school boy with cat-like instincts and nowhere to belong. His name is Nagisa—mysterious, quiet, and untethered from the world.

What begins as an unusual cohabitation gradually evolves into something deeper. As the days pass in their modest apartment, filled with shared meals, silences, and small moments of understanding, a delicate bond forms between them—one that challenges their assumptions about age, love, loneliness, and family.

But how long can something so fragile last? And when the world inevitably intrudes, will the connection they've built survive?

A gentle, bittersweet tale of connection, emotional healing, and the quiet stirrings of love—told through the rhythm of everyday life.

name: Tanshin Hanabi
summary: A salaryman who lives a happy life with his wife and daughter in Tokyo is suddenly transferred to Kagoshima, a place full of memories where he spent his junior high school years. However, soon after arriving at his new post, he reunites with his first love, and along with bittersweet memories, a hidden Pandora's box opens...

name: Shanai Shokeinin: Kanojo wa Teki wo Keshiteiku
summary: Honoka Asami, a pure but plain and introverted temporary office worker, is forced to work in a company where harassment is rampant and has nothing to do but endure. Fukase Nozomi, a new beautiful employee, stands out at work, catching the eyes of senior employees, and then she becomes close to Asami also deeply resonates with each other. After meeting and becoming close to Nozomi, Honoka gradually begins to feel that every day is fun. Meanwhile, a senior employee who had been harassing Honoka was forced to resign due to an incident that occurred in the company, causing a commotion. But that was just the beginning!

name: Chloe Ayling: My Unbelievable Kidnapping
summary:
Chloe Ayling: My Unbelievable Kidnapping is a documentary series featuring Chloe Ayling as she recounts, in her own words, the ordeal of her 2017 kidnapping and explores how it continues to shape her life.

Giving her first documentary interview since her abductors' conviction, Chloe Ayling revisits the story of her time in captivity and tries to come to terms with what took place, the media reaction and why many people refused to believe her.

name: Тайный знак
summary: Oleg and his father move to a quiet science city near Moscow, but he is quiet only at first glance. Arriving at a new school in the middle of the school year, the guy finds out that two girls from his class went missing the day before, and soon another victim appears.… However, against the background of these disturbing events, Oleg unexpectedly finds new friends. This is a group of once dysfunctional guys who have become leaders in just a couple of months thanks to the efforts of their homeroom teacher Baev. Oleg immediately attracts his attention, and soon the guy discovers the secret of a secret society, whose members can activate their physical and mental abilities. But what will be the price of these changes?

name: Midnight Panther
summary: Based on the Best-Selling Comics From CPM Manga! The traveling musical group The Pussycats is the hottest thing around. Lou, Kei and Sonya are three, sexy singers with a legion of screaming fans in every town. But these pussycats have claws. Singers by day, assassins by night. Unbeknownst to their fans, The Pussy Cats are also The Midnight Panthers—female assassins who will kill anyone if the price is right! Their next target is a despotic king who rules by fear and crushes dissension with an iron fist. But for one of the Panthers, it's not just another job... it's personal.

previousepisode.name: Eien no Kiss o Anata ni Ageru

name: Love Formula
summary: A simple rural girl, Jian Dan, meets the mathematics prodigy Han Yansheng at university. Due to an accident, Han Yansheng develops a swimming-related stress disorder. With kindness and perseverance, Jian Dan stands by his side and helps him overcome his inner fears. With support from their friends, the two grow together, finding both love and courage along the way.

name: Goddess Bless You from Death
summary: Thup, an orphan cursed with extraordinary senses, is drawn into investigating a mysterious murder case stretching across decades alongside the more rational police captain Singha, who dismisses all things occult. But what they face defies logic; this case is stitched together by ancient beliefs, supernatural forces, and the darkest corners of human desire. Every five years, new victims are lured by faith—victims drawn into temples by spiritual devotion, only to be sacrificed in a sinister ritual meant to prolong the killer's life. Thup and Singha must blend forensic science and ancient sorcery, navigating threats both visible and invisible. As the truth unravels, so too do the walls between them, until reluctant allies grow closer than either ever expected.

name: Dirty Neck
summary: A disgraced journalist returns to Dirty Neck, his Florida hometown, to become a local hero with the knack of reporting lurid stories of "stupid people doing stupid things", much to the chagrin of the town's controlling and shifty mayor.

name: Coastal Adventures with Helen, Jules & JB
summary: Helen Skelton, JB Gill and Jules Hudson take the ultimate coastal adventure in the UK.

name: Pecados Inconfesables
summary: Trapped in a controlling marriage, a woman starts an affair with a younger man for comfort and revenge, but their liaison transforms into a perilous battle to stay alive.

name: Geordie Stories: Charlotte, Mam of Two
summary:
Following the phenomenal success of Geordie Stories: Charlotte's New Baby, Paramount+ has commissioned another series with reality TV icon and fan-favourite Charlotte Crosby, and her fiancé, Jake, that follows the next chapter in their rollercoaster life. The four-part series, Geordie Stories: Charlotte, Mam of Two (wt), promises warmth, humour, and a no-holds-barred look into Charlotte's chaotic and heartfelt journey as a celebrity and a hands-on mother.

This time, the cameras follow Charlotte as she navigates the madness of raising two young children, while maintaining her career and juggling her personal life. From moving house to launching a book, to running her fashion brand and filming overseas, it's non-stop drama, love, and laughter at the Ankers Abode.

Viewers will follow Charlotte as she heads to Australia with both daughters in tow to film Paramount+ series Aussie Shore. Though her time abroad proves far from picture-perfect! Back in the UK, the family tackles a major change, moving out of their beloved Sunderland home into a new property mid-renovation. Jake works to grow his chauffeur business while managing his mental health post-burglary, and Charlotte gears up to release her first fiction book "Lucky Break".

This heartwarming and wildly entertaining series is a raw and real portrait of one of Britain's most beloved personalities, offering fans an exclusive look at the highs and lows of modern motherhood and fame.

name: Khemjira
summary: Khemjira is a young man who can see ghosts. He was born into a family cursed such that every male must die before the age of 21. As the spirits around him grow increasingly aggressive, the protective amulet he has worn his whole life begins to lose its power. Unable to bear seeing Khem in danger, Jettana, his friend from university, takes him to a rural village in the Northeast, where they meet Pharan, a revered teacher of ancient magic who once mentored Jettana. Strange and mysterious events unfold, all connected to the past life. Amid these supernatural encounters and the haunting pursuit of revengeful spirits, a deep emotional connection begins to form between Khem and Pharan.

name: Необычные люди
summary: Magicians and psychics, occultists and mystics. They have accompanied the world throughout history, and sometimes changed its course. We will tell you about the fates of unusual people of the last century: the healer of the Romanov family Nizier Philippe, the poet-magician Valery Bryusov, the composer Alexander Scriabin, the Soviet fortune teller Juna and many others. Mysterious legends, mystical duels, musical apocalypse and incredible predictions - everything that the turbulent twentieth century is remembered for. Why have people always sought to touch the unknown? Who and how practices magic these days? And how do miracles coexist with technical progress?

name: Reykjavik 112
summary: A woman is brutally murdered in front of her young daughter, the sole witness to the crime. The challenging case is assigned to Detective Huldar, who must unravel a web of perplexing clues while dealing with a traumatized child who has been rendered mute. To help unlock the girl's memories, Huldar seeks the expertise of a child psychologist-only to discover it's Freyja, a woman he recently had an awkward date with. Forced to collaborate, Freyja and Huldar must race against time to stop a killer who strikes again and remains perilously close.

name: Family Lockup
summary: In a bold bid to break the cycle of recidivism, Sheriff Nick Cocchi of the Hampden County Sheriff's Office in Massachusetts, is allowing estranged family members to spend two nights in jail to restore broken family bonds but when the cell doors close, will healing begin or will some inmates find themselves facing reintegration alone?

name: Dangerous Relationship
summary: Set in the year 2029, the drama follows university professor Liang Simu, who travels back in time to the day of his sister's death using a prototype code file he developed himself. Determined to uncover the truth behind her passing, he joins forces with his close friend Yue Ling. Together, the two rely on their intellect to uncover hidden truths and undergo personal growth along the way.

name: Good for Her
summary:
This contemporary sketch show is a fast-paced mix of music, social satire and keenly observed characters.

Viewers are introduced to a cast of quirky personalities, including Aileen, a podcast-hosting, latte-sipping, Pilates-loving Glasgow West End mum with strong opinions and even stronger delusions, a Scottish reporter who can't stop speaking in her "newsreader voice" and a mysterious woman who may (or may not) be… a rat.

name: Queer and Here
summary: Host Aniwa Whaiapu Koloamatangi takes us on an adventurous journey among the queer community.

name: Ocean Warriors: Mission Ready
summary:
The vicious waves of the icy Pacific are unrelenting. Once a boat gets in trouble, a wasted minute can mean the difference between life and death.

Ocean Warriors takes viewers deep into the First Nations communities of Canada's west coast, where the brave men and women of the Coast Guard Auxiliary put their lives on the line to help those in need.

Discover the hope and heartbreak, and the terror and tragedy faced by these everyday heroes. Brave crews reveal the inside-story of their nail-biting rescues where every minute counts, from capsized cruise ships to heart-pounding searches for missing people. Ocean Warriors is a series about the importance of connection to land, ocean and community, and what it takes to be mission ready.

name: Cry Wolf
summary: A psychological family thriller about a social worker and a mother who are thrust into crisis when the mother's teenage daughter alleges abuse, pushing both women to their limits as they navigate an impossible situation.

name: Forensics: Murder Case
summary:
For over four decades the brutal 1983 murder of Aberdeen taxi driver George Murdoch has remained unsolved, leaving a family without answers and a community wondering if his killer still walks among them. The brutality of the crime is underscored by the unusual weapon used in the murder, a cheesewire.

Presented by journalist Kirsty Wark and narrated by Unforgotten star Nicola Walker, this documentary delves into the details of the crime, exploring the significant advancements in forensics that have led to a major DNA breakthrough that could help solve the case.

name: The Secret Life of Trees
summary:
Narrated by Michael Palin, this fascinating series follows the incredible lives of trees - from their beginning as tiny seeds through to magnificent giants and into old age, revealing the secrets of how they communicate, how they drink and even how some of the three trillion trees on our planet are as old as the pyramids.

Even the mightiest oak must start life as a tiny acorn. In the first film, we explore the secret lives of young trees – discovering how they magically transform from minute seeds into mature adults. But with fewer than one in a thousand seeds reaching adulthood, a tree's early years are the most treacherous of its life.

name: Pompeii: Life in the City
summary:
Pompeii is the world's most incredibly preserved Roman city. Now historians Dan Snow and Doctor Kate Lister take us into this extraordinary time capsule, to reveal what it would really have been like to live there.

They discover everything from exactly what people ate, to where they slept (and who they slept with), what jobs they did and how dangerous the city was at night. This is real life in Pompeii in all its gritty, glorious detail.

name: Disaster at Sea: The Piper Alpha Story
summary:
On the night of 6 July 1988, 120 miles off the coast of Aberdeen, a devastating series of explosions ripped through Piper Alpha, one of the North Sea's flagship oil platforms. By the time dawn broke, Piper Alpha was in ruins. 167 men would die, only 61 survived.

Six months later a Public Inquiry was launched, led by Lord Cullen. It revealed that behind the disaster was a flawed safety culture within the main US owned operator, Occidental, and in the North Sea more widely. But no criminal charges were brought. It remains the world's deadliest offshore oil and gas disaster.

Now, 37 years later, Disaster at Sea: The Piper Alpha Story will revisit the events of that night and the months beyond, to reveal a bigger, untold story of the rush for North Sea ‘black gold', the working families shattered by Piper Alpha and the legacy of the disaster on industry and individuals for decades to come.

At the heart of the series will be the unique and compelling testimony heard in the Cullen Inquiry. Revoiced by actors, the words of the men who lived through that night tell a remarkable human story, one that speaks to tragedy, heroism, and an uncompromising quest to uncover the truth.
